name: Size slider bottoms out at "Size 1%" with a pin-prick dot
Size slider tops out at "Size 100%" with a massive dot
a Size 100% stroke is dramatically thicker than a Size 1% stroke
Opacity slider shows "Opacity N%" with the dot faded to match
all 45 brushes across 12 sets paint
smudge drags paint and the eraser removes it
undo/redo buttons and 2-/3-finger taps step history
layer opacity slider fades the layer
Merge Down combines the two layers
Delete is instant (no confirm) and the panel stays open
Undo brings a deleted layer back
a single tap on the colour disc picks a colour
modify-square eyedropper: loupe while dragging, red on lift, no paint
Colours panel eyedropper samples the composited blue and returns to the panel
touch-and-hold eyedropper shows the loupe and picks red
Automatic / Freehand / Rectangle / Ellipse selections all select
an inserted photo lands whole on the canvas, in Transform
a transform drag is one undo step
Freeform / Uniform / Distort / Warp all show the live Width/Height px readout
Copy (toast, Actions closes) → Paste adds a layer → Cut removes one
Insert a file adds an image layer
Flip horizontal mirrors the canvas
Canvas info shows the canvas size
two-finger pinch zooms + rotates together and glides on after release
a quick pinch-in snaps the canvas back to fit
three-finger swipe down opens Copy & Paste, acting on the current layer
four-finger tap hides the interface (full screen)
brush cursor outlines the brush under the finger while painting
Share image saves PNG (transparent) / PNG / JPEG at 4500×5400
More export options downloads every format at its size (Original = 4500×5400)
Save a copy saves to the gallery (toast, Actions closes)
Save version snapshots the project (toast with History)
Version history → Restore reverts the same canvas in place
Use in a post opens the composer with the design attached
Use as product photo opens the product picker with the design waiting
Use on mockup puts the design on the garment
